signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 3 US offices

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Platform
roles.location: Reno, NV; San Ramon, CA; New York, NY

bullets: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for platform capabilities that span multiple areas, and explain how they fit together into one platform story.
Build tools that let customers, partners, and Customer Experience teams make large-scale data and configuration changes safely, auditably, and without engineering help.
Enable AI to make implementation work self-service: guided workflows, AI-assisted bulk changes, and validation that catches problems before they reach a live workflow.
Treat internal teams as customers. Work with implementation, support, and partner teams to find the highest-cost manual work, streamline workflows, and drive operational…
Drive adoption of shared platform patterns across product teams, building alignment through clarity, evidence, and relationships rather than mandate.

roles.title: Senior Staff AI Product Manager, Agent Foundry
roles.location: San Ramon, CA; Reno, NV; New York, NY

bullets: Own product direction and roadmap for Ridgeline’s agentic capabilities, aligning customer and operations needs, platform strategy, technical realities, and business outcomes.
Lead high-visibility, multi-squad initiatives from discovery through launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement; establish clear goals and measures of success.
Identify and prioritize customer problems where AI agents and platform capabilities can create meaningful, differentiated value in investment management workflows.
Partner with engineering, design, data, and security to make sound decisions across model and architecture choices, orchestration, evaluation, integrations, reliability, and user…
Translate ambiguous opportunities into executable plans, make high-impact trade-offs, manage dependencies, and secure cross-functional alignment and resources.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Data Intelligence
roles.location: San Ramon, CA; New York, NY; Reno, NV

bullets: Curate and govern the datasets and data models the team exposes to Reporting Experience and other consumers, ensuring they carry consistent structure, provenance, freshness, and…
Partner with Engineering on Ridgeline’s distributed query platform to scale performant querying and analysis over large, complex, cross-domain datasets
Partner with domain teams (Accounting, Performance, Market Data, and others) to identify which reporting concepts need a shared, governed definition versus which should remain…
Write clear use-case documents, PRDs, and product definitions that make Reporting Data Curation’s promises to its consumers concrete and testable
Partner closely with Reporting Experience and Reporting Workflow to ensure Reporting Data Curation’s roadmap reflects real customer and product needs
